Female lower-limb muscles: Andreassen TE, Hume DR, Hamilton LD, Walker KE, Higinbotham SE, Shelburne KB (2023). Scientific Data 10:34. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01905-2
Original data: https://digitalcommons.du.edu/visiblehuman/1/

Geometry obtained from the public CC BY derivative: https://github.com/slorksmo/Human-Atlas (public/models/atlas-female.json and female-13.bin, female-14.bin). Only 76 donor-muscle records imported; no borrowed male bones.
Upstream adaptations: mesh simplification, per-region uniform scaling and placement onto HRA bones. Scales 0.9793–1.0084; bone agreement 17.4–36.1 mm. These are approximate educational placements, NOT registered image-space anatomy.
Our adaptations: translation 0.0000045009723258493395, 2.1298095131960793e-7, 0.06230792303121586 m to existing HRA scene, normals recomputed, Draco compression. Left/right femur frame discrepancy 0.00001249500351492198 mm. No additional shape fitting.
Do not use these supplementary meshes for quantitative distances or registered cryosection overlays.
